title: Tyrese Haliburton Celebrates Christmas Early  As He Rocks His Home Alone Collaboration With Nike
htmlContent:
The Indiana Pacers hosted the New York Knicks over the weekend in a game and we are five days away from the Christmas festivities. However, Pacers guard Tyrese Haliburton elected to celebrate Christmas earlier by paying homage to a classic movie. Haliburton brought his new kicks with Nike featuring Home Alone 2 characters.

On one side it features Marv and Harry with Iron Marks and battle scars.

On the other side we have a picture of the main protagonist, everyone’s favorite nosey kid Kevin. Who just keeps happening to get lost at just the right moment.

“Keep the change, ya filthy animal,” said the caption on Pacers' Facebook.

If you are unfamiliar with the movie, it is one of the famous lines from Home Alone 2 Lost In New York.

Haliburton Would finish with 15 points, 1 rebound, and ten assists in 32 minutes of play. Unforinately the Pacers would fall to the Knicks 109-106.
